quote.text: The human understanding when it has once adopted an opinion draws all things else to support and agree with it.
quote.author: Francis Bacon, Novum Organum (1620), Book I, Aphorism XLVI

stories.headline: La Marzocco publishes its boiler volumes; ECM and Olympia Express publish no price
stories.dek: The Linea Mini R holds half a litre for brewing and 3.5 for steam, and costs US$6,300. ECM and Olympia Express print no price on their own sites at all.

stories.headline: Netsuke became a collecting field with its own Kyoto museum and societies
stories.dek: A coat toggle became a collecting field with 46 years of quarterly scholarship, a Kyoto museum holding over 6,000 pieces, and a record near a million euros.

stories.kicker: The Travel Desk · Singapore Airlines’ New Cabins
stories.headline: Singapore Airlines unveiled four new cabins and confirmed passengers wait until late 2027
stories.dek: The airline put more than S$2 billion of seats on a stage at Marina Bay Sands on 6 November. The business seat is 22 inches wide against 28 on the one it replaces.

stories.headline: Kremlin says Putin, Xi and Trump will meet in Shenzhen on Thursday
stories.dek: Dmitry Peskov put the date on the record on Saturday, a day after the White House. Beijing, which is hosting, has confirmed no such meeting.

stories.headline: Singapore’s HDB reports a $4.70 billion deficit as completions fall a quarter
stories.dek: The Housing and Development Board’s annual report of 11 November shows the government grant down $1.62 billion to $4.73 billion, and 15,417 flats finished against 20,294.

stories.headline: Tim Scott summons Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick over Nvidia’s China exports
stories.dek: Letters dated 12 November ask Nvidia’s departed chief to appear on 3 December and the Commerce Secretary on 10 December, with subpoenas threatened if either declines.

stories.headline: Klipsch returns to headphones with the Stratos pair at $999.99 and $1,199.99
stories.dek: The closed-back HP-2 and semi-open HP-3 were shown at CanJam Dallas on 14 November, reach American shops in December and Europe in January 2027.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Zenith And J.N. Shapiro
stories.headline: Zenith puts J.N. Shapiro’s name on its own dial, 25 pieces at CHF 68,900
stories.dek: Announced on 12 November, the rose-gold G.F.J. carries a silver dial cut in southern California — US$83,150 in American boutiques, and no published Singapore price.

stories.headline: Johnny Depp’s Ebenezer opened at number one with $6.7 million on Friday
stories.dek: Paramount’s Ti West-directed Dickens adaptation took $6,700,000 from 3,535 American cinemas on 13 November; the studio projects $20 million for the weekend.

stories.headline: The University of Manchester finds sleep and belonging protect school attendance
stories.dek: The University of Manchester team followed children aged 12 and 13 across nine terms in 156 schools. Nine in ten barely wavered; the 7.6 per cent who slipped were already struggling.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The December Hike
stories.headline: Futures price a December Fed increase at 100 per cent after October’s inflation prints
stories.dek: The two-year Treasury yield rose 37 basis points in the week to 4.88 per cent. Gold fell 4.6 per cent and bitcoin broke its 200-week average.

stories.headline: A Faroese football trial missed its muscle target and raised fitness anyway
stories.dek: Published 5 November, the randomised trial of 111 adults aged 40 to 70 found lean mass up 0.04 kilograms — and aerobic capacity up 2.80 points on half-attendance.

stories.headline: Tokyo Auto Salon 2027 opens ticket sales for 15 to 17 January
stories.dek: Makuhari Messe on the Friday costs ¥4,000 and the weekend days ¥3,000 — digital tickets only, credit card only, resale prohibited and no refunds.

stories.headline: Mongolia opens the sale of 1,072 Tavan Tolgoi shares to 3.5 million citizens
stories.dek: A 2012 resolution banned disposal “in any form”. In June this year the stock exchange signed a memorandum to undo it — in a year the dividend fell to about nineteen US dollars.
